{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-md-c","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"48dfae9f0f9c5e3bde1d50201c9eb0acba6d1c5596784ed09666a1ff8b96f205","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-md-class-c:lineage:73","source_registry_sha256":"fac6b4b22cda98085a5d7df11947d7cc05865e6c877c17be3df4d573863d1518","source_liveness_sha256":"43fe3511474bec2a914f5cdb112291b78f4339942c4d6fb903d9e3bae34bb3fc"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Driving situations and conditions (continued, confusables)","heading":"C2 — Hydroplaning, railroad crossings, work zones, roundabouts, highways, funerals and slow vehicles, with confusables","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Hydroplaning, railroad crossings, work zones, roundabouts, highways, funerals and slow vehicles, with confusables

FACT_ID: sec07-F39 | anchor: A30
Hydroplaning happens when speed and standing water rise until the tires ride on a sheet of water and lose contact with the road, costing some or all control. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F40 | anchor: A30
To prevent hydroplaning, keep tires in good shape and slow down on wet roads. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F41 | anchor: A30
If you start hydroplaning, lift off the gas, do not brake, keep the vehicle straight and slow until control returns. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F42 | anchor: A30
Trains cannot stop quickly, so take extra care approaching and crossing railroad tracks. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F43 | anchor: A30
Buses, school buses and trucks hauling hazardous materials must stop before every railroad crossing, so expect them to stop ahead of you. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F44 | anchor: A30
A train can come from either direction at any time and may be nearer and faster than it looks. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F45 | anchor: A30
Lowered gates or flashing warning lights mean the road is closed for now; stop and wait until the gates rise and the lights stop. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F46 | anchor: A30
After a train passes, look both ways and confirm the tracks are clear, since a second train may be on another track. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F47 | anchor: A30
Never start across tracks unless you can clear them fully before a train arrives and there is room for your vehicle on the far side. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F48 | anchor: A30
In an emergency on or near a crossing, leave the vehicle and move away from the tracks, then report it using the blue and white Emergency Notification System sign. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F49 | anchor: A30
A work zone is a stretch of road where construction, maintenance or utility work is under way, and it may be stationary or move slowly along the road. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F50 | anchor: A30
Work zones can bring new traffic patterns, narrow or shifted lanes, closed lanes and shoulders, pavement drop-offs and shorter sight distance. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec07-F51 | anchor: A31
Orange is the work-zone color, so orange signs mean pay close attention and expect unusual conditions ahead. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F52 | anchor: A31
Flashing amber or yellow lights in a work zone mean workers are present, so obey the signs, slow down and watch for them. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F53 | anchor: A31
Work zones may use speed cameras, flashing blue lights show the cameras are active, and speeding fines can be much higher there, higher still with workers present. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F54 | anchor: A31
Flashing green lights may appear on highway maintenance vehicles or service equipment in and ahead of work zones. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F55 | anchor: A31
In a work zone be ready to stop fully if traffic ahead stops, avoid distractions, merge carefully, do not tailgate, change lanes only if needed, and obey the flagger. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F56 | anchor: A31
Roads leading into a traffic circle have yield signs, and you must always yield to vehicles already in the circle. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F57 | anchor: A31
Approaching a roundabout, slow down, keep right of the island, yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk, and wait at the yield line for a gap; with no traffic in it you need not wait. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F58 | anchor: A31
In a multi-lane circle stay in your lane, and once you pass the exit before yours, signal right and move to the outside lane. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F59 | anchor: A31
A limited access highway is a large road with no intersections or traffic lights and few entry and exit points; an interstate is one that runs between states. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-F60 | anchor: A32
You reach a highway by an entrance ramp, use the acceleration lane to match the speed of highway traffic, and must not cross the solid lines between the entrance and the highway. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F61 | anchor: A32
If you are slower than highway traffic, you must keep to the right lane whenever possible. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F62 | anchor: A32
To exit, move right well before your exit, begin slowing in the deceleration lane, and slow to the exit ramp's posted limit. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F63 | anchor: A32
If you take the wrong exit, keep going off the ramp and find a way back; never stop and reverse anywhere on the highway. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F64 | anchor: A32
Stopping in moving highway lanes is not allowed; use the shoulder only for a breakdown or other emergency, turn on flashers and stay inside if you can. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F65 | anchor: A32
Drivers in a funeral procession must use headlights and flashing hazard lights, and with lights on they may go through a red signal. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F66 | anchor: A32
Other drivers, even on a green signal, must yield to a funeral procession until it has all passed unless they can go without crossing its path. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F67 | anchor: A32
Slow moving vehicles include bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles and farm vehicles, and a slow-moving sign on the back warns they go 25 miles per hour or less. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-F68 | anchor: A32
Near slow vehicles, adjust speed and position, pass only when safe, and use your emergency flashers while following one to warn drivers behind you. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec07-R01 | anchor: A27
High beams must drop to low at least 500 feet before an oncoming vehicle but at 300 feet or less behind a vehicle you follow. [A27]
Why it matters: group_hint headlight-distances; prereq_hint sec07-F11; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec07-F12, sec07-F13, sec07-F06.
Source: [A27 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec07-R02 | anchor: FXP0029
In a hydroplane you do not brake, while in a skid you may brake once the tires grip again [FXP0029] [A30].
Why it matters: group_hint loss-of-control; prereq_hint sec07-F36; difficulty_hint 4; confusable_with sec07-F41, sec07-F38.
Source: [FXP0029 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec07-R03 | anchor: A31
Flashing amber or yellow in a work zone means workers present, flashing blue means speed cameras are active, and flashing green marks maintenance vehicles. [A31]
Why it matters: group_hint work-zone-lights; prereq_hint sec07-F51; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec07-F52, sec07-F53, sec07-F54.
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec07-R04 | anchor: A32
An acceleration lane is for speeding up to join highway traffic, while a deceleration lane is for slowing down to leave it. [A32]
Why it matters: group_hint highway-ramps; prereq_hint sec07-F59; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec07-F60, sec07-F62.
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-md-c:maryland-department-of-transportation-mo:handbook:pdf-0032]
